arabic_html:
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ ۞
hook:
When you don't know
how to cope.
translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: patience and prayer are Allah's two tools to ease every affliction. And the closing promise — Allah is with the patient — is a special nearness: His help and support for those who hold on.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: patience and prayer are Allah's two tools to ease every affliction. And the closing promise — Allah is with the patient — is a special nearness: His help and support for those who hold on.
